weeks.title: Week 1: Lease Classification & Initial Measurement
weeks.lessonHtml:
Week 1: Lease Classification & Initial Measurement

Learning Objectives

  • Classify leases using ASC 842 criteria
  • Calculate initial lease liability (PV of lease payments)
  • Measure ROU asset (liability + initial direct costs + prepayments - incentives)

Key Topics

1. Finance vs. operating lease (lessee)

This topic covers essential CPA exam concepts related to Finance vs. operating lease (lessee). Understanding this material is critical for both passing the CPA exam and applying these principles in real-world CFO scenarios.

CFO Application: As a CFO, you will regularly apply Finance vs. operating lease (lessee) concepts in financial reporting, strategic decision-making, and compliance with GAAP standards. This knowledge directly impacts your ability to prepare accurate financial statements and provide guidance to management.
CPA Exam Tip: Finance vs. operating lease (lessee) is frequently tested on the exam. Focus on practical application, authoritative guidance citations, and computational accuracy.

2. Sales-type vs. direct financing vs. operating (lessor)

This topic covers essential CPA exam concepts related to Sales-type vs. direct financing vs. operating (lessor). Understanding this material is critical for both passing the CPA exam and applying these principles in real-world CFO scenarios.

CFO Application: As a CFO, you will regularly apply Sales-type vs. direct financing vs. operating (lessor) concepts in financial reporting, strategic decision-making, and compliance with GAAP standards. This knowledge directly impacts your ability to prepare accurate financial statements and provide guidance to management.
CPA Exam Tip: Sales-type vs. direct financing vs. operating (lessor) is frequently tested on the exam. Focus on practical application, authoritative guidance citations, and computational accuracy.

3. ROU asset and lease liability

This topic covers essential CPA exam concepts related to ROU asset and lease liability. Understanding this material is critical for both passing the CPA exam and applying these principles in real-world CFO scenarios.

CFO Application: As a CFO, you will regularly apply ROU asset and lease liability concepts in financial reporting, strategic decision-making, and compliance with GAAP standards. This knowledge directly impacts your ability to prepare accurate financial statements and provide guidance to management.
CPA Exam Tip: ROU asset and lease liability is frequently tested on the exam. Focus on practical application, authoritative guidance citations, and computational accuracy.

Practice Application

Work through practice problems applying week 1: lease classification & initial measurement concepts. These problems mirror actual CPA exam scenarios and real-world CFO challenges.

Key Takeaways

  • Master Finance vs. operating lease (lessee) for exam success and professional competence
  • Master Sales-type vs. direct financing vs. operating (lessor) for exam success and professional competence
  • Master ROU asset and lease liability for exam success and professional competence
  • Understand authoritative guidance and when to apply it
  • Practice computational problems until you can solve them efficiently
  • Connect concepts to real-world CFO responsibilities

weeks.title: Week 4: Modifications & Sale-Leaseback
weeks.lessonHtml:
Week 4: Modifications & Sale-Leaseback

Learning Objectives

  • Account for lease modifications (separate lease vs. remeasurement)
  • Identify reassessment triggers (lease term, residual value guarantee)
  • Apply sale-leaseback rules (sale vs. financing)
